advisory_rule: Without `advisory`, NHC's newest advisory for the storm: the one its newest CurrentStorms entry is of (issued_ts, then fetch), so a text-only post-tropical advisory counts; for a storm with no entry, the newest official forecast (newest init_ts, then position valid time, never the string). Per product, the copy in force (pantry 294). init_ts is the advisory's synoptic time, from its official forecast; null where NHC issued none.
wsp_rule: WSP is issued per synoptic cycle, basin-wide, not per storm: the cycle is the advisory's synoptic time (its official forecast's init_ts) as YYYYMMDDHH. Bands are the 5 km zip's contours (11 percentage bands); the grid is the half-degree zip's points, value in percent, cells below 0.1 % absent.
revision_rule: revision and corrected are each object's own (the ledger's copy in force and meta.correction); `original` is the uncorrected copy where one is corrected. The top-level revision is the highest served; source_in_force says whether the NHC file an object names is the copy in force now.
index_rule: Each object is a vintage-ledger row of the display bucket (tropical_file_vintage_in_force, source 'parsed', product 'display:<name>', r2_key = the display key), served as the ledger states it: url = https://display.energylake.io/<r2_key>. The API reads no R2 and fetches no object. The contract is recon d091737 §7's; d091740's spec was not readable when this route was written.

reasons.not_issued: NHC issued none: its CurrentStorms entry for this advisory links no such product, or links an earlier advisory's file
reasons.basin_has_none: NHC issues storm surge watches and warnings for the US Atlantic and Gulf coasts only
reasons.not_banked: the bank holds no copy of the NHC file this would be published from
reasons.not_published: the NHC file is banked; no published display object is in the ledger

not_served.object_bytes: This API reads no R2 and serves no object bytes: every url is the display bucket's, and the browser fetches it.
not_served.alerts: NWS tropical watches and warnings (api.weather.gov) have no route here: the page fetches them directly (recon d091737 §5).

nhc_terms: NOAA/NHC products are public domain. They are served as the bank parsed them, are not presented as NHC's own official display, and imply no endorsement.
